After hearing scratching noises, I found out that I had raccoons hanging out on my third floor roof and living in chimney. I checked Angie's List and called Critter Control. My first point of contact was with Jessica, who listened to my problem, then clearly explained their process and the possible costs involved. She emailed a contract to me immediately, and after providing them with some information, Steve and Bryan came out right away to assess the situation and make recommendations, which I accepted. They came by the house everyday to monitor the situation, and after the critters were gone, they installed 2 new stainless steel chimney caps, along with a dryer vent. I am so relieved that they could resolve my unfortunate situation in a professional and timely manner.

Ian returned my call the same morning that I left a message. Steve arrived at the stated time and examined my home. He quickly identified the animal that was causing the problem. He set a trap and caught the raccoon that night. The next day he came and removed the juveniles. Steve suggested some improvements to block access to the our house in the future.  I had Steve install these and have not had any problems since.
I would recommend these guys to anyone.

We contacted Critter Control after we had trouble getting rid of a squirrel in our attic space. Jake Kerr responded very quickly to our initial request and worked with us to trap the squirrel and seal off the entry point. He was professional and friendly and very responsive to our needs and requests.

I asked for a cash discount and he said yes.  He came and did the work and handed me a bill for the full amount.  I asked him about the discount, and he told me that he forgot.  I suggested that he void the invoice and write a new one.   He said he couldn't do that.  I gave him a credit card to pay and he was upset.  He said I had promised him cash, but he had also promised me a discount.
He really knows his stuff.  He's punctual. He's very helpful if your scared to deal with the animals.  He's real confident in his work.
They did a good job. They were quick and they did what they said they would do. They were good.

They were responsive but extremely expensive. The person, who came to do the job and check the situation was highly experienced and very good; but, the price for the service was very expensive. The overall experience was good; it took care of, the problem. I don't have another price to compare their pricing with because they were the only ones that came out. I would probably try to find someone else the next time because of their pricing.

They were prompt. The young man that had his certification in wildlife was very good. But they were very expensive for what they did. It turned out to be a very costly situation for me to find out I didn't have a problem.

The young man was very efficient and good at his job.  He did exactly what he said he would do.  I have never had work like this completed before, so I wasn't sure what the prices would be.  I thought the prices were very high, but their prices could be the going rate for the work completed.  My neighbor ended up installing screens to block the access points for me so I wouldn't have to pay for that installation. I would use them again in the future if I have a problem.  Now I am aware of what the prices could be though.
They came out and took care of the problem.  They were efficient.  I hardly even saw the workers.  They were fine.  They were professional.

The only reason I gave them a D, instead of an overall F, is due to how quickly they showed up for the initial visit (coincidentally, this is the visit where they get paid).  I ended up losing a day of vacation, waiting on someone to show up for the follow-up visit and  the person who was supposed to come, never came.  Apparently, my messages were being forwarded to a black hole.  Finally, caught the flying squirrel without any of their traps and  it took them 4 days to pick the traps up off of my front porch.

We called him to remove the live bird that had fallen down our chimney and was trapped in our living room fireplace behind the glass screen. He came immediately and removed the bird, which turned out to be a robin, to his surprise. He gave us a "free" estimate for chimney caps at that time and charged us close to $200 (which seemed high for critter removal that didn't take very long and didn't seem very dangerous).  We decided to get the chimney caps and dormer seals because this was the second time in 10 years that a bird had gotten trapped in one of our two chimneys. The price for the additional work was high but seemed reasonable, given the materials and labor.  It also included a 10% senior discount, which was appreciated.

Worked with Rob Puskas, he showed up on time everyday and was very pleasant I was worried about how the repair would look but it blends in to the surrounding brick. Would hire again but I hope I don't have to.

Critter Control responded quickly to our call. They came out to set traps the day after we called, and returned each day to check them and remove the animals. They say that they release them in a park.  After all 5 squirrels were caught (that's a lot, according to them) they gave us an estimate to "squirrel-proof" (my words) the house.  We chose to have them do most of the suggested items, with the exception of the chimney caps, which were thousands of dollars.  They put mesh over the dryer/fan vents, the vents in the attic, holes the squirrels had dug, etc.
They seemed high in price to me.
